Estimated from the photo, the meal is about 8 salmon and cucumber sushi rolls, a fruit bowl, a brownie, a cup of milky tea, and small pots of ginger, soy sauce and wasabi.

| Item | Mass (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Sushi, 8 pieces at ~30 g each | 240 | ~350 |
| Fruit salad | 150 | ~75 |
| Brownie with powdered sugar | 50 | ~220 |
| Tea with milk | 250 | ~40 |
| Ginger, soy sauce and wasabi | 30 | ~15 |

The sushi estimate assumes rice at about 1.4 kcal/g, plus the salmon and cucumber.

The total is about 700 kcal and 720 g.
